answer: A glove is cut only to the hand chart the glover keeps for each customer, and the chart is measured anew every year. A violet glove bought ready-made fails the chart: at the crystal of the fingers the leather must follow the customer's own measurements, and a strange glove pinches or gapes. Forging a chart means bribing a glover, measuring a hundred hands and paying 4,300, and the canyon chart in the shop drawer is checked at every fitting, so a glove cut to no chart is sent back.
